strings.en: Three farms · Kalba, Sharjah · Ras Al Khaimah
Farmhouses you get to keep for the weekend.
Grand Haven, Happy Haven and Green Haven — pools, lawns, barbecue yards and animals, each handed over whole. Walk them in 360° before you call.
Every farm is booked whole — never shared, never by the room. A caretaker stays on site, the pool is cleaned the morning you arrive, and the animal yard is yours to help feed.

Twelve acres between the Kalba mangroves and the Hajar foothills. A long heated pool, a shaded kids' pool, a majlis that seats sixty, horses and a camel at the far gate. Sleeps 18, hosts 60 for the day.

The one built for children. Eight acres an hour from Dubai with a trampoline, a cycling track, a football pitch and the animal yard nobody leaves. Two heated pools, a covered barbecue deck, and your dog is welcome. Sleeps 14, hosts 40.

A mango and citrus orchard with a low white house at the centre, one heated pool under a pergola, and a barbecue terrace built for slow evenings. Five acres, no neighbours in earshot. Sleeps 10, hosts 30.
Three farms, one team. Not three separate hosts you hope reply.
You get the gate code and the entire farm — the pool, the lawn, the majlis, the yard. No shared plots, no other group on the land.
Every room is cleaned before you arrive and again after you leave. Fresh linen every booking, and the pool tested before each arrival.
One WhatsApp thread, 8am to 11pm, usually answered inside fifteen minutes — by the people who actually run the farm.
Drive times, road surface, gate access, pool heating months and house rules are all published on each farm page before you book.
in the corner — there is a longer list in there, and it points you to the farm manager when a question needs a person.
How do I book a farm?

Call or WhatsApp the farm manager with the farm, the dates and the number of guests. We hold the farm for 24 hours while you confirm, then a refundable security deposit locks it in. A self-serve availability calendar is coming to this site soon.
Why are prices not on the site?
Rates move with the farm, the season and whether it is a day booking or an overnight stay. Everything else you need is on these pages — so when you call, the only thing left to discuss is the number.
What are the check-in and check-out times?
Overnight stays run 3pm to 12pm. Day bookings run 10am to 10pm. Early check-in is often possible when the farm is free the night before.
Yes — the house, the pools, the lawns, the barbecue yard and the animal area are yours for the booking. Only the caretaker stays on site, and only in the service quarters.
At Happy Haven, yes, on request — it is the pet-friendly farm. The other two keep livestock loose in parts of the plot, so guests' animals stay home.
Birthdays, family gatherings, corporate days and shoots are welcome. Amplified music must be down by 10pm, and weddings need written approval first.
No smoking indoors, no fireworks, no alcohol on the farms, no unregistered overnight guests, and music down by 10pm out of respect for neighbouring farms.
WhatsApp or call, 8am–10pm. Prices are given on the phone.

strings.en: Twelve acres between the Kalba mangroves and the Hajar foothills. You get the gate code, the whole farm, and a caretaker who stays out of the way.
Pick a spot, then drag the image to look around — scroll to zoom.

Grand Haven is the largest farm in the club — twelve acres of date palms and lawn on the Kalba side of the mountains, where the air comes off the Gulf of Oman. The house is low and thick-walled: eight bedrooms, a majlis that seats sixty, and doors that open straight onto grass.

Behind the palms is the working half of the farm: the goat and sheep yard, a chicken run, two horses and a camel with a handler who takes children out at sunset. Feeding is at 7am and 5pm, and it is the part every guest remembers.
Evenings happen at the barbecue yard — two charcoal grills under a covered deck, long tables, and string lights that go on at seven. Music down by ten; the neighbours are farms too.
Play area: swings, frame, sand pit
Two horses and a camel, with handler
The practical half of the farm — how you get here, what we do between stays, and which months are the good ones. Everything below is published before you book, not after.
Drive times are off-peak, from city centre to gate.
1 h 45 min via E611 and the Sharjah–Kalba road
Tarmac to the gate. No 4×4 needed — the last 600 m is a graded farm track, flat and fine for a saloon car. Gated parking for 20 cars inside the wall.
We send the pin, the gate code and the caretaker’s number on WhatsApp the morning of your stay, and again an hour before check-in. Nobody waits at a locked gate.
Etisalat and du both full strength across the plot. Wi-Fi reaches the majlis, the bedrooms and about half the lawn.

Every room is cleaned before you arrive and again after you leave — not turned over between two groups on the same day. The farm is managed by one team across all three properties, so the standard does not depend on which caretaker is on.
Bedrooms and bathrooms cleaned before check-in and after check-out
Fresh linen and towels for every booking
Pool tested and treated before each arrival
Kitchen, majlis and barbecue yard cleared down between stays
Caretaker on the plot, reachable and out of the way
October to April — the Kalba side stays two or three degrees cooler than inland
On from November to March, no extra charge — tell us when you book
June to September the lawn is for early morning and after five; the majlis is air-conditioned all day

Questions about Grand Haven go straight to the person who runs it. We answer on WhatsApp between 8am and 11pm, usually within fifteen minutes.
Guests, rooms, pets and pools — the answers that differ farm to farm. General booking and payment questions live on the
How many people can stay at Grand Haven?
Eight air-conditioned bedrooms with 18 beds, so 18 guests overnight. For day bookings the farm takes 60 — the majlis seats 60 and the lawn holds more.
How many bedrooms and bathrooms are there?
Eight bedrooms, each with its own bathroom, plus two guest bathrooms off the majlis and a changing room by the pool.
Can we bring our own pets?
No. Grand Haven keeps goats, sheep, horses and a camel loose in parts of the plot, so guests’ animals have to stay home. Happy Haven is the pet-friendly farm in the club.
What animals are on the farm?
Goats, sheep, chickens and rabbits in the yard, two horses, and a camel with a handler who takes children out at sunset. Feeding is at 7am and 5pm and guests are welcome to join.
Is there a pool, and is it heated?
A heated 20m pool and a separate shaded kids’ pool. Heating runs November to March at no extra cost; say so when you book and it is on before you arrive.
What are check-in and check-out times?
Overnight 3pm to 12pm; day bookings 10am to 10pm. Early check-in is usually fine when the farm is free the night before.
How much parking is there, and how far is Dubai?
Gated parking for 20 cars. It is about 1h45 from Dubai and 45 minutes from Fujairah.
Can we host a wedding or a large event here?

Grand Haven is the farm built for it — 60 seated in the majlis, a covered barbecue yard and two grills. Birthdays, corporate days and shoots need no approval; weddings and amplified stages need written approval, and music is down by 10pm.

strings.en: Eight acres an hour from Dubai, built around the children — and the one farm where your dog is welcome too.

Happy Haven is the farm families come back to. Eight flat acres of lawn and shade trees in the Ras Al Khaimah countryside, an hour from Dubai, with a six-bedroom house that opens onto the grass on three sides.

Everything here is built for children: a trampoline, a cycling track that loops the plot, a grass football pitch, swings and a sand pit, and a shallow shaded pool beside the heated main one. The animal yard — goats, sheep, chickens, rabbits — is open all day and feeding is at 7am and 5pm.
It is also the only farm in the club that takes guests' pets, on request. Evenings run long on the covered barbecue deck; music down by ten.
8 acres of lawn and shade trees
1 h via E311 and the Emirates Road
Tarmac the whole way to the gate. Any car is fine. Gated parking for 14 cars, with space to turn a minibus.
Full coverage on both networks. Wi-Fi reaches the house, the majlis and the play lawn.
October to April, with March and April the best for the play areas
In summer the trampoline and cycling track are morning and evening; the kids’ pool is shaded all day
Feeding at 7am and 5pm year round — children can join both
Questions about Happy Haven go straight to the person who runs it. We answer on WhatsApp between 8am and 11pm, usually within fifteen minutes.
How many people can stay at Happy Haven?
Six air-conditioned bedrooms with 14 beds, so 14 guests overnight, and up to 40 for a day booking.
Six bedrooms — two of them family rooms with bunks — four bathrooms, and an outdoor shower by the pool.
Yes. Happy Haven is the pet-friendly farm in the club — tell us on booking so the caretaker keeps the livestock penned while your dog settles in. Well-behaved dogs only, and not in the bedrooms.
Is this the right farm for small children?
It is the one built around them: trampoline, swings, sand pit, a cycling track, a shaded kids’ pool and a fenced play lawn you can see from the majlis.
What animals can the children meet?
Goats, sheep, chickens and rabbits, all hand-reared and used to children. Feeding is at 7am and 5pm, and the vegetable rows are yours to pick from.
A heated main pool and a shallow shaded pool for toddlers. Heating runs November to March at no extra cost.
How far is it from Dubai, and where do we park?
About an hour from Dubai, in Ras Al Khaimah. Gated parking for 14 cars.
1h from Dubai · 25 min from RAK city
A mango and citrus orchard with a low white house at the centre. The quiet farm — five acres, no neighbours in earshot.

Green Haven is five acres of mango, lime and citrus in the Ras Al Khaimah interior, with a low white house at the centre and a pergola-shaded pool that stays cool through the afternoon. Four bedrooms, a majlis for thirty, and quiet in every direction.

The orchard is worked, not decorative — the caretaker will walk you through the rows and let the children pick whatever is in season. Behind it sits the animal yard: goats, sheep, chickens and rabbits, fed at 7am and 5pm.
The barbecue terrace was built for slow evenings — one long table, two grills, and the kind of dark sky you only get this far from the coast road.
Play area: swings and sand pit
Tarmac to the gate, then a short gravel drive through the orchard. Any car is fine. Gated parking for 10 cars under the trees.
Full coverage on both networks. Wi-Fi is strong in the house and patchy at the far end of the orchard — which some guests count as a feature.
October to April; the orchard holds its shade longer than an open plot
Ripe May to August — pick what you can eat
Limes and oranges through the winter months
Questions about Green Haven go straight to the person who runs it. We answer on WhatsApp between 8am and 11pm, usually within fifteen minutes.
How many people can stay at Green Haven?
Four air-conditioned bedrooms with 10 beds, so 10 guests overnight, and up to 30 for a day booking. It is the smallest and quietest farm in the club.
Four bedrooms, three bathrooms, and a pergola shower next to the pool.
No — the orchard has loose livestock and fruit rows we would rather not lose. Happy Haven is the pet-friendly farm.
One heated pool under a pergola, shaded most of the day. Heating runs November to March at no extra cost.
Yes, in season — mangoes from May to August, limes and citrus through the winter. Take what you can eat; the rest goes to the market.
Is Green Haven suitable for children?
Yes, though it is the calm farm rather than the playground one: swings, a sand pit, a lawn and hammocks. Families wanting a trampoline and a cycling track should look at Happy Haven.
Can we host an event, and is there parking?
Small gatherings up to 30 — birthdays, retreats, shoots. Gated parking for 10 cars, and amplified music is down by 10pm.
1h10 from Dubai · 40 min from RAK city
